mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 23, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: Brass as dark bronze on squid01 and squid02's opaque body; the sliding glow keeps lamplight. See sheet_f0_tint_from.
sheet_f0_tint_from: The user's, 2026-09-30, in several passes. 'i think those tentacles has to be metallic', then 'looks blue', 'less bronze and more in sync', and at last MuMain's own picture of the pit, a pale olive gold (120:105:85, 1 : 0.87 : 0.70), and 'lets make it dark bronze'. So brass (cast, roughness 0.44) at f0 0.45, with #E8C050 baked into the metal sheet (sheet_f0_tint; the cook drops glTF's baseColorFactor, so a sheet_tint never reached the game). The blue is left out of the tint on purpose: the Dungeon's fill is cold, and any blue in a metal's f0 turned the worms mauve. Tried and turned down: plate steel (blue), #FF9A50 (copper), wrought iron at 0.25 (grey), #FFCC80 (mauve). An invention on MU's look: MU lights squid01 as any other sheet.
why_this_one: A giant worm, a second shape, 17 of them: the same body arched over the floor. Seen in the world 2026-09-30 at 131.9,246. See echo_from.
additive_from: A departure, marked. MoveObject's WD_1DUNGEON arm (ZzzObject.cpp:3880-3885) makes mesh 1 a StreamMesh: drawn unlit at full light and its V slid one sheet a second. squid02 is a soft glowing rib pattern on black, so unlit it is that pattern over dark; this engine slides only a glow, and added over black it reads the same.
echo_from: MU draws mesh 1 as a StreamMesh: opaque, unlit at the object's flat BodyLight, its V slid one sheet a second (ZzzBMD.cpp:1344-1369, :1819; ZzzObject.cpp:3880-3885). This engine slides only an added glow, and an added sheet that is black but for its ribs has no body: the worm drew with holes where its squid02 segments were, and read as separate dark pipes. So squid02's faces are drawn twice (export_gltf's tiled echo): once opaque as squid02_body, the same near-black sheet, lit and still, and once added and sliding as the glow. Black under an add is MU's opaque dark sheet with its ribs moving. Ours, marked: the body is lit rather than unlit, and its ribs do not slide under the glow's (squid02's mean is 6 of 255, so neither shows).
animation_note: Rigged: its one action of 40 keys plays at CreateObject's default 0.16; MuMain's Dungeon arm sets it no speed of its own.
